assembly: copy ../modern/r.-1.0.mca to dimensions/minecraft/overworld/region/ and ../modern/level.dat to level.dat; every chunk is DataVersion >= 5006, so the 26.3 codec applies throughout
note: 'chunks' is the fixture as read: each stored palette entry's form and the state it decodes to, defaults restored and properties in name order. 'reads' are point reads and 'surfaces' all four heightmaps, both before any edit; a read outside the chunk's min_y..max_y is null even where a section of light alone is stored. 'steps' run in order on the same world (fills, connects and thaws with keep_loaded); then 'blocks_after', 'palettes_after' and the per-chunk digests of the UNCOMPRESSED NBT must all match.

steps.why: source water into a deep, all-default section: the list stays strings
flowing water carries a property: the list widens and every bare id is wrapped
a partial state: the omitted waterlogged is filled from the defaults before it is stored, in name order
a state spelled with its default value is the default: stored bare, wrapped
spelled out in full, source water finds the bare entry the first step made
a chain dropped into water holds it: the game gives every chain waterlogged
a bell displaces it: the bell has no waterlogged property to set
a lone fence derives all-false, which is its default: bare, in a uniform air section that must grow an index array
its neighbor connects both: two full entries, and the air list widens
thawed ice is written as water[level=0], which the codec stores as the bare id
a default state into a surface section the game already stored as compounds
and a non-default one beside it
not an edit but the case the fixture lacks: the game keeps a section of light alone one past the top of the world, Y=20, and it is no part of the chunk's range, which stays -64..319
so a door on the top of the world, whose upper half would stand in that section, is refused whole: nothing is written
keys as 26.3 reads them, defaults filled: the bare furnace is its default, and a chest key that leaves facing out means north. The chests keep their block entities, the furnaces lose theirs
not an edit either: a chunk without the section at its floor still counts from the floor it records, yPos * 16, not from the lowest section it stores
